tier_label: Bilateral AI cooperation framework; license-free access for BIS-approved entities
source_name: BIS Final Rule / Morgan Lewis summary
rationale: BIS moved the UAE from Country Groups D:3/D:4 into A:5 on 10 Jul 2026 and named G42, Core42, and eight US AI firms as approved end users who can receive advanced chips license-free under a new Advanced Computing Items exception -- but only the parties listed in Supplement No. 8 to Part 740, so treatment is entity-specific, not unconditional national access.

source_name: Vision2030.ai / trade press reporting on Nov 2025 Commerce authorization
rationale: On 19 Nov 2025 Commerce authorized HUMAIN (and separately UAE's G42) to each purchase up to the equivalent of 35,000 Nvidia GB300-class accelerators, subject to security/reporting conditions and BIS compliance monitoring. This is favorable but capped, conditional, and short of a country-wide rule -- Saudi Arabia did not receive the UAE's July 2026 upgrade.
